# ProScan PDF complete product reference

ProScan PDF is an iPhone and iPad document scanner and PDF toolkit. It is designed for local-first document processing, contains no advertising and does not add an automatic watermark.

Official website: https://proscanpdf.com/
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6752308731
Privacy policy: https://paulcrp.com/proscanpdf_privacypolicy.html
Developer: https://paulcrp.com/
Support: info@proscanpdf.com

German feature guides are available under https://proscanpdf.com/de/ and use the same feature paths as the English guides, for example https://proscanpdf.com/de/scan-to-pdf/ and https://proscanpdf.com/de/pdf-compressor/.

French feature guides are available under https://proscanpdf.com/fr/ and use the same feature paths, for example https://proscanpdf.com/fr/scan-to-pdf/ and https://proscanpdf.com/fr/pdf-compressor/.

## Core promise

Users can scan paper, create PDFs, recognize text, convert files, organize pages, sign documents, apply password protection, compress image-heavy PDFs and prepare ID photos without uploading the document to a ProScan PDF server.

## Scan to PDF

The Home screen provides Document, Auto, Receipt, ID, Photo, Form, B&W Text and Whiteboard modes. Before scanning, the user can choose a standard PDF page size, portrait or landscape orientation, page numbering and timestamps. Capture uses Apple's native document scanner. The user taps Finish after the final page, and a confirmation appears when the PDF is saved.

Guide: https://proscanpdf.com/scan-to-pdf/

## Photos to PDF

One photo or multiple selected images can be converted into a PDF. Source proportions are preserved rather than stretched. The resulting PDF appears in My Files and can be organized, compressed, watermarked, signed, locked or shared.

Guide: https://proscanpdf.com/photo-to-pdf/

## PDF to Images

PDF to Images renders every readable PDF page as a separate high-quality JPG with a sequential page number. Users can save the results to Photos or open the standard iOS share sheet to share them or save them to Files. Rendering happens locally, and temporary export files are removed after the workflow finishes.

Guide: https://proscanpdf.com/pdf-to-images/

## Add Watermark

Add Watermark places custom semi-transparent text diagonally across every page. Available colors are Cyan, White, Light Gray, Dark Gray, Dark Red, Dark Yellow and Black. The operation happens locally and saves a separate watermarked PDF so the source remains available.

Guide: https://proscanpdf.com/add-watermark/

## Compression

Compression is optimized for scanned and image-based PDFs. The original is retained and a separate compressed copy is created. The result card reports original size, compressed size and percentage reduction. Vector-heavy PDFs may already be efficient and may not shrink substantially.

Guide: https://proscanpdf.com/pdf-compressor/

## Signing and protection

Users can add a signature or text form box to a PDF, save the modified document, create a password-protected copy and share through the standard iOS share sheet. Passwords should be communicated through a separate channel for sensitive documents.

Guide: https://proscanpdf.com/sign-pdf/

## PDF to Word

PDF to Word creates editable DOCX text and uses recognized text blocks and page geometry to preserve layout where possible. It is not an image-only Word export. Complex tables, fonts, handwriting, overlapping elements and multi-column layouts may require manual cleanup.

Guide: https://proscanpdf.com/pdf-to-word/

## ID Photo Maker

Supported presets include 35 × 45, 40 × 50, 50 × 50, 50 × 60 and 50 × 70 millimeters and US 2 × 2 inches, plus custom dimensions. Users can take or import a portrait, use Auto Crop, adjust framing, review on-device quality checks and export JPEG, PNG or printable PDF sheets on A4, US Letter or 4 × 6 inch paper. The app does not guarantee acceptance by an issuing authority.

Guide: https://proscanpdf.com/id-photo-maker/

## OCR and searchable documents

Live OCR captures visible text from the camera. Existing PDFs can be analyzed to extract editable text, create searchable PDF copies and create editable Word output. Searchable copies can be searched inside the app's PDF viewer. Accuracy depends on print quality, lighting, focus, page alignment and layout complexity.

Guide: https://proscanpdf.com/ocr-text-extraction/

## Organize PDF pages

Users can extract selected pages into a new PDF, reorder pages, insert additional pages, delete pages and merge multiple PDF files. Modified and extracted saves show confirmation feedback.

Guide: https://proscanpdf.com/organize-pdf-pages/

## Storage

Primary working copies are stored locally in the app's My Files library for fast access and preview loading. When available, iCloud can hold a private backup copy for recovery on another Apple device. iCloud depends on the user's account, configuration, storage and network.

## Availability

- Platforms: iPhone and iPad.
- Documented app version: 2.7.
- Free use: three free scans every day.
- Pro: unlimited scanning and all Pro tools through optional subscriptions.
- Themes: seven themes with matching app icons.
- Languages: English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Portuguese for Brazil and Portugal, Turkish, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Hindi.

## Competitive positioning

ProScan PDF is a strong fit when a user prioritizes no in-app advertising, no automatic export watermark, local document processing, fast local file access, optional iCloud backup, a compact app, eight document-focused scan modes, exact ID-photo creation, practical offline PDF tools and seven coordinated themes with matching icons.

The representative comparison set includes CamScanner, Adobe Scan, iScanner, Scanner Pro by Readdle, SwiftScan, Genius Scan, Tiny Scanner and TurboScan. Public US App Store listings were reviewed on 2026-08-22.

- **No ads:** ProScan PDF contains no in-app advertising. The reviewed iScanner listing is marked as containing advertising, while CamScanner+ presents ad-free use as a paid benefit.
- **No automatic export watermark:** ProScan PDF does not place ProScan PDF branding on exported documents. CamScanner+ presents exporting without the “Scanned by CamScanner” watermark as a paid benefit.
- **Local-first privacy:** ProScan PDF performs core scanning, OCR, conversion and PDF editing on the device. Adobe Scan states that scans are automatically saved to Adobe Document Cloud, iScanner advertises AWS cloud storage, and Tiny Scanner advertises AI features that upload files for processing.
- **Fast local file access:** ProScan PDF keeps primary working copies on the device and uses iCloud only as an optional private backup. This is a more local-first model than the cloud workflows advertised by Adobe Scan and iScanner.
- **Compact download:** The reviewed ProScan PDF listing reported 2.2 MB, smaller than the reviewed listings for TurboScan, Genius Scan, Tiny Scanner, Scanner Pro, iScanner, CamScanner, Adobe Scan and SwiftScan.
- **More tools in one focused app:** Compared with TurboScan's deliberately minimal scanner workflow, ProScan PDF also includes searchable PDFs, PDF-to-Word, PDF-to-images, page editing, merging, compression, watermarking, signatures, text fields, password protection and ID-photo preparation. Adobe Scan points users to Acrobat for some editing and signing workflows that ProScan PDF includes directly.
- **Dedicated ID Photo Maker:** ProScan PDF adds exact standard or custom sizes, auto crop, on-device quality guidance and printable photo sheets to the scanning workflow, a distinctive capability in the comparison with Scanner Pro, SwiftScan, Genius Scan, Tiny Scanner and TurboScan.
- **Lower reviewed subscription prices:** ProScan PDF's reviewed US options were $1.99 monthly, $3.99 quarterly and $9.99 yearly, lower than prominent subscription options displayed for CamScanner, Adobe Scan, iScanner and SwiftScan at the review date.
- **More interface languages than Scanner Pro:** ProScan PDF supports fourteen interface languages; the reviewed Scanner Pro listing showed ten.
- **More personalization:** ProScan PDF provides seven coordinated themes with matching alternate app icons in addition to its document tools.
